one_sentence_argument: Under one deployable execution contract, MAP owns average logical-error performance; regime/event/fallback logic owns tail safety; RTL owns deterministic execution; and learning modules remain replaceable extensions whose claims activate only through their own gates.

roles.responsibility: paper-level system that composes performance, safety, atomic update and deterministic execution contracts
roles.output_authority: system orchestration only; it does not own a new decoder score

roles.responsibility: produce logical-coset LLR/decision and own decoder-lane LER
roles.output_authority: logical decision and MAP-LUT candidate image

roles.responsibility: infer normal/smooth/shift/burst/leakage posterior from observed history
roles.output_authority: update permission/freeze/trusted-bank proposal; never the logical action

roles.responsibility: convert accepted observations and safety state into hold/recovery/reset modes
roles.output_authority: event mode, reset request and hysteresis state

roles.responsibility: fail closed on uncertainty, integrity, freshness or deadline faults
stage, validate, atomically commit and roll back last-known-good parameter images
execute the latched fixed-point MAP/event/action contract with deterministic core timing
roles.output_authority: registered action/state words and core-cycle evidence, not host estimation

roles.responsibility: optional learned slow-loop proposal under matched budget
roles.output_authority: bounded proposal only; never primary system or unqualified LER owner

roles.responsibility: offline high-capacity controller target inside the controller lane
roles.output_authority: training target/control residual; not a decoder oracle

roles.responsibility: optional bounded controller recurrence distilled from a teacher
roles.output_authority: controller extension action subject to safety wrapper

roles.responsibility: provide an isolated nondeployable upper reference
roles.output_authority: upper-bound decision/gap only; excluded from deployable aggregates

terminology_ledger.rule: owns registered execution timing, not host estimation
controller training target, never RNN decoder/oracle

surpass NMF before paper-exact reproduction and paired lifetime gate
surface-code raw decoder latency as direct single-mode GKP ranking

claims.canonical_wording_en: We define a contract-centric, regime-aware safe adaptive dual-loop in which MAP decoding owns logical-error performance, regime/event/fallback logic owns tail safety, and the FPGA fast path owns deterministic execution.
claims.canonical_wording_zh: 本项目已冻结 contract-centric、regime-aware 安全自适应双回路：MAP 负责逻辑错误性能，regime/event/fallback 负责 tail 安全，FPGA fast path 负责确定性执行。
revocation_conditions: a component is allowed to claim another component's metric
lane nonmixing is removed
forbidden_wording: one model solves decoding, safety and hardware latency

claims.canonical_wording_en: The production fast-path core is cycle-exact against an independent integer reference over one million board-independent CXXRTL qualification cycles.
claims.canonical_wording_zh: production fast-path core 已在板卡无关 CXXRTL 中以独立整数 reference 完成百万周期全字段 cycle-exact 资格验证。
revocation_conditions: source/trace hash changes without rerun
any bit mismatch or undefined action appears

claims.canonical_wording_en: The current fixed-point fast path has a target-device-specific three-seed place-and-route timing and resource estimate; it is not a board measurement.
claims.canonical_wording_zh: 当前定点 fast path 具有目标器件、三 seed 的 P&R 时序/资源估计，但不是板测。
activation_gate: source/constraint hashes and all three P&R seeds pass
revocation_conditions: tool report or constraint hash changes
estimate is presented without target/clock qualifier

claims.canonical_wording_en: [Conditional; not currently supported] Under a shared protocol-aligned trace and compute contract, Route-A reduces aggregate and tail logical error relative to the strongest deployable static GKP decoder.
claims.canonical_wording_zh: 仅当同 trace/预算证据通过时，Route-A 才可声称相对最强可部署 static GKP decoder 改善 aggregate/tail LER。
activation_gate: T6.8.1 same-trace paired CI supports the claim
revocation_conditions: aggregate paired 95% LCB is not positive
any preregistered tail gate fails

claims.canonical_wording_en: [Conditional; not currently supported] Under matched history, update cadence and compute budget, Route-A improves drift adaptation without violating preregistered abrupt/OOD safety margins.
claims.canonical_wording_zh: 仅在 matched history/cadence/预算与 OOD 安全门通过后，才声称 Route-A 具有一般漂移适应优势。
claims.data_domain: held-out smooth and abrupt/OOD syndrome scenarios
activation_gate: T6.8.2 includes at least one reproducible external method
revocation_conditions: external implementation is unavailable
catastrophic-degradation or nominal non-inferiority gate fails

claims.canonical_wording_en: [Conditional; not currently supported] Regime-triggered freeze, trusted-bank switching and fail-closed fallback reduce harmful tail events without unacceptable nominal fallback cost.
claims.canonical_wording_zh: 仅当 abrupt/OOD 与 nominal non-inferiority 门同时通过时，才声称 regime freeze/trusted-bank/fallback 改善 tail 安全。
revocation_conditions: calibration-shift counterexample persists
nominal fallback cost exceeds frozen margin

claims.canonical_wording_en: The legacy CNN residual is a replaceable matched-budget ablation and is not required for the Route-A system claim.
claims.canonical_wording_zh: legacy CNN residual 仅是 matched-budget 可替换消融，不是 Route-A 成立前提。
activation_gate: may be promoted only by its own T6.6/T6.7 matched gate
revocation_conditions: matched comparison fails
checkpoint is absent or cost is unmatched

claims.canonical_wording_en: A low-dimensional student retains a preregistered fraction of teacher gain in the existing bounded project controller simulator, but this is neither official GQF reproduction nor decoder evidence.
claims.canonical_wording_zh: 低维 student 在既有受限 controller simulator 中具有预注册 teacher gain-retention 证据，但不等于官方 GQF 复现，也不是 decoder 证据。
activation_gate: existing T4.4.5 bounded branch remains current
revocation_conditions: official GQF is implied
long-horizon/OOD retention is implied
controller result is used as decoder evidence

claims.canonical_wording_en: [Not currently claimable] In the same official GQF environment and budget, the Route-A extension improves logical-channel lifetime over Puviani NMF.
claims.canonical_wording_zh: [当前禁止] 在同一官方 GQF 环境与预算下超过 Puviani NMF 的 logical-channel lifetime。
revocation_conditions: absolute values or ordering miss reproduction tolerance
paired lifetime LCB is not positive

claims.canonical_wording_en: [Not currently claimable] The Route-A FPGA decoder is faster than existing FPGA QEC decoders on a matched task boundary.
claims.canonical_wording_zh: [当前禁止] Route-A FPGA decoder 在同任务边界下比现有 FPGA QEC decoder 更快。
revocation_conditions: only core/P&R estimate is available
code/problem/precision/latency boundary differs
any board deadline miss occurs

claims.canonical_wording_en: [Not currently claimable] The system exceeds physical break-even or a measured physical-memory lifetime record.
claims.canonical_wording_zh: [当前禁止] 系统超过真实物理 break-even 或物理存储寿命记录。
activation_gate: protocol-aligned physical-device experiment with registered passive reference and lifetime uncertainty
revocation_conditions: evidence is simulation, CXXRTL, P&R or board-only digital control
